related.title: CBOR：主型別、短整數與二進位交換
related.titleEn: CBOR: major types, short integers and binary interchange
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付xml-tree.json及prefix／URI對照；不以文字replace取代XML解析。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver xml-tree.json and prefix/URI comparisons without replacing XML parsing with string replacement. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 分離major type與低五bits，先讀長度再讀payload；逐項記offset避免跨界。
related.differenceEn: Separate major type from the low five bits, read lengths before payloads and trace offsets to prevent overruns.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
XML名稱的namespace URI與local name構成語意身分；prefix只是局部別名。外部實體解析政策須明確且預設不取外部資源。
本課數值核對：3+1 = 4 element_nodes；另一項核對：2-1 = 1 redundant_prefixes。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

CBOR初始byte包含major type與additional information；同樣數值可有不同編碼，確定性編碼另有約束。
本課數值核對：1+1+1+2 = 5 B；另一項核對：24-23 = 1 value_gap。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Namespace URI plus local name identifies an XML name; prefixes are local aliases. External-entity policy must be explicit and default to no external fetching.
Numeric audit: 3+1 = 4 element_nodes; second audit: 2-1 = 1 redundant_prefixes. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

A CBOR initial byte contains major type and additional information; a value can have multiple encodings, while deterministic encoding adds constraints.
Numeric audit: 1+1+1+2 = 5 B; second audit: 24-23 = 1 value_gap. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: SQLite：UPSERT 與重播匯入冪等性
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付xml-tree.json及prefix／URI對照；不以文字replace取代XML解析。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver xml-tree.json and prefix/URI comparisons without replacing XML parsing with string replacement. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 用來源事件 ID 作唯一鍵，證明重跑匯入不重複計費。
related.differenceEn: Use source event IDs as unique keys and prove replay does not double-charge.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
XML名稱的namespace URI與local name構成語意身分；prefix只是局部別名。外部實體解析政策須明確且預設不取外部資源。
本課數值核對：3+1 = 4 element_nodes；另一項核對：2-1 = 1 redundant_prefixes。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
冪等需要穩定的業務鍵及明確衝突政策；任意 INSERT OR REPLACE 可能刪除再插入。 教學基準：30+40+20+10 = 100 unique-event total；第二檢核：30+40+20+40+10 = 140 naive append total。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Namespace URI plus local name identifies an XML name; prefixes are local aliases. External-entity policy must be explicit and default to no external fetching.
Numeric audit: 3+1 = 4 element_nodes; second audit: 2-1 = 1 redundant_prefixes. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Idempotence requires a stable business key and explicit conflict policy; INSERT OR REPLACE can delete then insert. Teaching baseline: 30+40+20+10 = 100 unique-event total; second check: 30+40+20+40+10 = 140 naive append total. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
